title: PIE ANVIL DASH
oneLiner: Dodge the falling anvils and catch every delicious pie you can!
mechanics: Move the baker left and right beneath the dropping treats.
Falling anvils hurt; catching pies earns points.
Pies appear faster and anvils fall more often over time.
Grab golden pies for bonus points.

controls.a: Dash briefly in your moving direction

lose: Lose when an anvil hits the baker.
scoring: Earn points for catching pies, with bonus points for golden pies.
